newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen up after Sept machinery orders data.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen up after Sept machinery orders data.

text.p: The key June three-month Euroyen futures contract hit a day's high of 99.13 on Tuesday afternoon after data was released showing a sharp 10.2 percent month-on-month drop in private machinery orders for September, traders said.
However, the gains were short-lived as the EPA also gave its forecast for a steep 19.3 percent rise in orders for the October-December quarter against the previous quarter, they said.
The June stood at 99.10 as of 0510 GMT, up from Monday's 99.08.
